# Join a party

[User guides](index.md) | [Français](fr/player-join.md)

On your Pleey instance, open the relevant screen and select the question-mark button in its header to show the guide. The links below use the local installation; replace the host and any :parameter with your own address and resource identifier. Player guidance is available in the lobby before timed play.

<a id="join-identity"></a>

## Confirm your identity

Open the host's join link. Use your account or choose a guest nickname. Enter the password if the party is private.

[Show guide](http://pleey.localhost/join/:pin?guide=player-join)

![Confirm your identity](assets/player-join-join-identity-en.png)

<a id="join-submit"></a>

## Ready to play?

Join the party, then wait in the lobby for the host. If joining is unavailable, check the party status and ask the host for help.

[Show guide](http://pleey.localhost/join/:pin?guide=player-join)

![Ready to play?](assets/player-join-join-submit-en.png)
